parts.text: An airport has only 3 planes that fly multiple times a day.
Each day, the first plane goes to Greece for half of its flights, and the remaining flights are split equally between flights to France and flights to Italy.
The other two planes fly exclusively to Spain, and their combined 60 trips only amount to half the number of trips the first plane makes throughout each day.
How many flights to France does the first plane take in one day?
